title: Principles of the Measured Duel
summary: Teaches a champion to open and win a single formal exchange with the jian through measure and a decisive finishing thrust.

title: The Sword Arm and the Whole Body
summary: Roots every cut and thrust of the jian in the legs and hips and spine so power travels through the blade.

title: Art of the Circling Blade
summary: Builds a style of ring-shaped cuts and orbiting steps around a fixed opponent with the slender sword.

title: Principles of Qi Extension Along the Blade
summary: Teaches an adept whose qi forms a living field to extend that field along the length of the jian.

title: Handbook of Smooth Defense
summary: Turns every parry of the jian into a flowing counter that carries the opponent's force back on itself.

title: The Dual-Track Jian Method
summary: Trains the body track and the qi track of one swordsman in paired step so that cut and breath move as one.

title: The Hawk's Stoop for the Slender Sword
summary: Teaches a perched watchful guard that breaks into a diving thrust and a raking pass like a hawk.

title: Azure Reach Manual
summary: Opens the jian's reach under a clear sky with long clean lines of cut and thrust and an arching guard.

title: River Basin Sword Lessons
summary: Teaches bending cuts and a pooling guard that follow the course of a river through its basin.

title: Wind-Sworn Jian Lessons
summary: Binds the student's cut and step to the wind by oath so the slender blade rides gusts instead of fighting them.

title: Plateau Edge Treatise
summary: Teaches fighting along a cliff rim with the jian where one wrong step ends the exchange.

title: The Held Bearing
summary: Fixes a bearing on the opponent and holds it through every cut and thrust and step of the exchange.

title: The Wall-Less Blade
summary: Teaches the jian as a weapon of open ground that guards by moving and never by standing still.
